annotations.exact_quote: Recent progress in deep learning has greatly improved clustering by allowing neural networks to capture richer and more abstract feature representations.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究基于深度神经表示的无监督聚类，SVGCA用VAE与注意力学习聚类友好嵌入，符合深度聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: Additionally, SVGCA integrates structure-aware attention and dual self-supervision to reinforce the learning of cluster-friendly embeddings.
annotations.reason_zh: SVGCA在图上使用结构感知注意力学习聚类友好嵌入，属于图上可学习消息传递/注意力聚合的图神经网络方法。

annotations.exact_quote: SVGCA incorporates Variational Autoencoders (VAE) to model the probabilistic structure of data, which inherently enhances noise robustness through stochastic sampling during training.
annotations.reason_zh: 引入VAE对数据概率结构建模并通过随机采样训练，涉及变分近似后验推断，满足贝叶斯推断定义。

annotations.exact_quote: Additionally, SVGCA integrates structure-aware attention and dual self-supervision to reinforce the learning of cluster-friendly embeddings.
annotations.reason_zh: 双自监督将自监督/聚类产生的监督信号反馈用于训练嵌入，符合将模型预测或自监督信号作为后续训练信号的伪标签/自训练设定。

abstentions.reason_zh: structure-aware attention只提示利用或关注结构，未说明学习或修正样本间边、邻接或亲和矩阵，无法确认图结构学习。
